method: Direct verification of supplied 2x2 matrices by multiplication in both orders, or a nonidentity witness. No new inversion algorithm.
easy: Integral first matrix, entry denominators at most 3.
moderate: Dense integral first matrix, at least two reduced quarter entries overall, entry denominators at most 4.
hard: Dense rational matrices, at least two fractional entries in the first matrix and five overall, denominators at most 6.
bounds: Absolute supplied entries at most 4. Bounded rational domains; no claim of unlimited variants. Search is capped at 1000 candidates per requested band and shortages remain explicit if distinct candidates run out.
deduplication: Exact rational supplied matrices and statement relation roles, ignoring seed, UUID, witness location, bank order and template aliases.
